load_urdf_plane: load a URDF plane model into a PyBullet GUI simulation environment
get_visual_shape_texture_uid: get the texture unique ID from a loaded URDF visual shape using getVisualShapeData
load_texture_png: load a PNG texture file into PyBullet and retrieve its texture unique ID
change_visual_shape_texture: swap the texture on a visual shape by setting a new textureUniqueId via changeVisualShape
render_camera_image_loop: render camera images in a loop to visualize texture changes in the PyBullet GUI
